name: GetResponse
summary: Email marketing with landing pages, automation and webinars in one suite, priced by contact count. The better rates need long commitments.
best_for: small businesses that want email plus landing pages, automation and webinars in one affordable suite
skip_if: you only need basic broadcasts — a leaner tool costs less without the extra modules you won't use
honest_knock: Priced by contact count, so the entry number climbs as your list grows, and the best value only shows on long (annual/24-month) commitments. A solid all-rounder, but you lock in to get the good rate.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month billed annually (€16 monthly), quoted at 1,000 contacts
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-02 on their own pricing page, in euros, quoted at 1,000 contacts) Starter €16/mo or €13.12/mo billed annually: 1 automation workflow, up to 3 users. Marketer €54/mo or €44.28 annual: unlimited workflows, ecommerce tools, advanced segmentation, abandoned-cart recovery. Creator €62/mo or €50.84 annual: website builder, course creator up to 500 students, webinars. Enterprise is quote-only and adds SMS, a dedicated IP and sending domain, SSO and unlimited users. Annual billing saves a stated 18%, and prices step up at 1k, 2.5k, 5k, 10k, 25k, 50k and 100k contacts. What changed since our August 2026 reading is the free tier: the pricing page no longer sells one. It opens with a 14-day trial that needs no card, and nine fresh loads on 14 September 2026 each showed the same four plan cards with no free option among them. Free accounts have not been withdrawn altogether — the FAQ on that same page still describes a Free account that keeps working once the trial lapses, with limits on webinars, messages, landing pages, marketing automation and chats — but it is no longer a tier you can pick from the grid, so treat it as what the trial decays into rather than as a plan. One currency warning survives unchanged: that same FAQ quotes the entry plan at $19 a month for 1,000 subscribers while the plan grid served us euros, so check which currency your own checkout uses before you budget. Charities and NGOs are offered 50% off every monthly plan. Re-read on 2 October 2026: every amount above unchanged and still no Free card in the grid; the help article the FAQ links to describes the Free account as capped at 500 contacts, 2,500 messages a month and 1,000 unique visits across all landing pages, after which those pages go offline. Read again on 9 October 2026 with the list-size selector, in euros, monthly / billed yearly per month: Starter €16 / €13.12 at 1,000, €27 / €22.14 at 2,500, €48 / €39.36 at 5,000, €69 / €56.58 at 10,000, €149 / €122.18 at 25,000, €259 / €212.38 at 50,000, €469 / €384.58 at 100,000; Marketer €54 / €44.28 at 1,000, €69 / €56.58 at 2,500, €82 / €67.24 at 5,000, €99 / €81.18 at 10,000, €189 / €154.98 at 25,000, €319 / €261.58 at 50,000, €519 / €425.58 at 100,000; Creator €62 / €50.84 at 1,000, €79 / €64.78 at 2,500, €94 / €77.08 at 5,000, €114 / €93.48 at 10,000, €219 / €179.58 at 25,000, €369 / €302.58 at 50,000, €599 / €491.18 at 100,000. The selector ends at '100,000+', which showed the 100,000 prices.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 28 October 2026 on the free trial: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We imported two made-up contacts, generated one email with AI, exported the contacts, imported them again with one change and opened the Starter checkout without paying.
findings: The trial banner said 'Your trial expires in 14 days', while the welcome message in the same account said 'For the first 30 days, you'll have access to features from all our plans'. No card was asked.

The contact counter started at 1 of 500: the sign-up address itself is added as a contact. Importing a CSV requires ticking 'I have permission to add these people to my list'; without it the import stops.

A tags column in the CSV could not be mapped per row; you can only assign the same tags to the whole import, and tag names allow only letters, numbers and underscores. A custom field could be created during the import. Import statistics said 'Added to list 0' while both contacts were in the list.

The AI email generator allows three runs in the trial ('Runs left: 3', then 2). With a topic but no facts, it invented pros and cons for the tools, such as 'Affordable pricing with a solid free tier'.

Export leaves tags and custom fields off unless you tick them. With both on, the CSV kept both contacts, their GetResponse IDs, the shared tag and our custom field, but showed no consent columns although we selected them.
Importing the file again with one changed name updated that contact by email address; the other stayed the same and no duplicate appeared. The import statistics still said 'Updated 0'.

In-app prices are net. Starter for 1,000 contacts billed yearly came to €192, minus €34.56 prepaid discount, plus €33.06 tax (21%): €190.50 in total. Team roles require an upgrade; generating an API key is offered in the trial.
not_tested: Sending an email or running an automation
What happens to the account and data when the trial ends
Cancelling (the account settings showed no billing section during the trial)
Team roles (only available after an upgrade)
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
